## About me

I am a Postdoctoral research fellow in Biostatistics at the [Harvard SPH](https://www.hsph.harvard.edu/biostatistics/) and the [Dana-Farber Cancer Institute](https://www.dana-farber.org/research/departments-centers/data-science), where I work with Professors [Jeff Miller](https://jwmi.github.io/) and [Giovanni Parmigiani](https://scholar.harvard.edu/parmigiani/). I obtained my Ph.D. in Statistical Science at [Duke University](https://stat.duke.edu/), under the supervision of Professor [David Dunson](https://scholar.google.co.uk/citations?user=KwEOawwAAAAJ&hl=en). 

My goal is to develop statistical methods to model [hidden phenomena]{.red} in biology and environmental science.

I am also an elected officer of [j-ISBA]{.blue}, the junior section of the International Society for Bayesian Analysis, supporting the community of young Bayesians across all continents.
